_readme: Small config the agent reads/writes each run. artifactUrl is filled in after the first successful publish and must be reused (not regenerated) on every subsequent run so updates land on the same page instead of creating a new one each day.
pagesPublishScope: every run — uses GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN if set (scheduled cloud runs), else the local gh CLI
lastRunStatus: Weekly research run. One evidenceScore change (distributed-deskilling-risk-widespread-ai-reliance 2->3, maturity Leading Edge/Experimental->Emerging Practice) on genuine new independent corroboration from Wharton's Oct 2026 AI Adoption Report (43% perceive skill-decline risk), the first corroboration of BCG Henderson Institute's single-source de-skilling finding. Five other opportunities gained new evidence with no score change: (1) ai-bifurcates-it-staffing-support-contracts-infra-grows added QA/Test Engineering as a role tag with real BLS 2025-35 data (+6% growth, 187,600->198,200) -- this run's under-covered-role target, closed with genuine government evidence rather than tagging. (2) it-io-teams-adopt-ai-cost-optimization-stall-roi added two Oct 2026 Gartner releases (13% of CIOs report transformational AI value realized; 77% of boards expect productivity/cost savings but only 3% of orgs achieve them), extending the ROI-stall thesis from I&O up to the CIO/board level. (3) middle-management-overload-compression added a same-event Gartner data point (79% of CHROs say managers are overwhelmed). (4) engineers-shift-to-orchestration-oversight added an Oct 2026 HBR piece (Christian Catalini) naming verification as the emerging scarce skill -- a sixth institution and third tier, lifting corroborationBreadth 4->5 with evidenceScore arithmetic unchanged at 4. (5) ai-compresses-engineering-team-size-junior-pipeline added a newly-surfaced Federal Reserve Board working paper (Crane & Soto, FEDS 2026-018, Mar 2026) finding coder employment decelerated for occupation-specific (not industry) reasons since ChatGPT -- a seventh institution/fourth tier, with evidenceStrength conservatively held at 4 rather than 5 pending a stricter causal design. Red-teamed all thirteen evidenceScore>=4 opportunities; no reliability>=3 evidence reversed any thesis. MIT CISR's announced Oct 31, 2026 closure has now passed with no new content found -- dropped from the mandatory-every-run priority list in sources.json per the prior run's recommendation (Census BTOS is now the sole mandatory source). No new opportunities founded. QA/Test Engineering is now meaningfully better-evidenced (3 opportunities, up from 2, with its first government data point); Product Management, Data Engineering, and Help Desk/IT Support were not independently targeted this run. BLS, Federal Reserve Board, Gartner, HBR, and Wharton all reset to 0 consecutiveEmptyRuns on genuine new admissible findings; Census BTOS, OECD, WEF, McKinsey, Deloitte, Bain, BCG, PwC, EY, Accenture, Forrester, IDC, NBER, and SIM continue or begin climbing without a new admissible finding this run. GitHub Pages mirror publish status recorded after site/publish_pages.py --verify ran (see below).
pagesTokenPermissions: fine-grained PAT, repository access limited to sdm1130/ai-it-research-tracker, Contents: Read and write (Metadata: Read-only is added automatically). Nothing else required: main has no branch protection or rulesets, and Pages is build_type=legacy on main:/ so it rebuilds on push.

pagesPublishExitCodes.3: no credentials — skip and report mirror stale
pagesPublishExitCodes.1: real failure e.g. expired token — report loudly
